title: A valuation ring is Noetherian exactly when it is a discrete valuation ring or a field
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a valuation ring is Noetherian exactly when it is a discrete valuation ring or a field (statement lines 12313-12317). The proof does not quote the classification of Noetherian valuation rings: in one direction it uses the explicit description of the ideals of a discrete valuation ring to exhibit generators and get a principal ideal domain, and in the other it translates the ascending chain condition into the value group and deduces that the group is a copy of the integers (proof lines 12319-12342). The translation between ideals and the value group in the converse is the content, and the author writes both directions out. H2.
